name: What are the tax implications of selling my home and renting it back?

mainEntity.name: What are the tax implications of selling my home and renting it back?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selling your home, even with a leaseback, is considered a taxable event, and you may be subject to capital gains tax depending on your profit, ownership duration, and eligibility for exclusions. The rental payments you make would typically be considered a personal living expense, not tax-deductible for you. It's an important preparation step to consult with a qualified tax advisor to understand the specific tax implications for your situation, as these can vary significantly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling triggers capital gains tax implications, and rental payments are generally not tax-deductible; consult a tax advisor.
